author: reek
body: The other half of stringbuilder-alias, closing the gap its prose records: here the builder is a LOCAL bound from a call rather than a declared parameter. sb-new's registered return type is the mutable StringBuilder, so the binding owns the record the moment the call answers, and handing it to two owners is the same aliasing whichever way it arrived. Before the minted-mutable walk this chapter compiled clean and the in-place appends corrupted both results into alphabeta|alphabeta; the identical body with base as a parameter was already refused. Both shapes must be CDX2062.
